movies.webm is a 3-second silent solid-colour video generated for this repository's player tests with FFmpeg's color filter. It contains no third-party footage, music, images or other content. QCC dedicates the generated fixture to the public domain under CC0-1.0. It is test-only and is not shipped in public/ or the production build.
long-resume.webm is a 40-second silent video, 160 by 90 pixels, VP9 in WebM, added for this repository's local video test. Its frames are one colour, rgb(31, 39, 48), except a 64-pixel patch at the top left of its first 21 frames that is one level brighter in each channel. It has one video stream and no audio stream, so it contains no third-party footage, music or images. Its encoder tags are FFmpeg's (libavformat 60.16.100, and libavcodec 60.31.102 with libvpx-vp9). The command and the colour source are not recorded in the file. It is test-only and is not shipped in public/ or the production build.
